summary: AQUARESORT AS (org. no. 932 574 640) is a private limited company (AS) based in Rælingen, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2023-12-06. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 68.120 (Utvikling og salg av byggeprosjekter); it has 0 registered employees. In its 2024 accounts (company level) net income was NOK 47 924. Board chair: Stig Jarle Sunde.
